preconditions.description: The number of mountains n is an integer between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.
The input heights form a list of exactly n integers.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= h[i] <= 10**12 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each initial height is a non-negative integer not exceeding 10^12.

preconditions.expression: all(h[i] < h[i+1] for i in range(n-1))
preconditions.description: The initial heights are strictly increasing.

postconditions.description: The total sum of heights is preserved after the landslide.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] <= return_value[i+1] for i in range(n-1))
all(return_value[i+1] - return_value[i] <= 1 for i in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: The difference between any two adjacent final heights is at most 1, meaning the sequence is as flat as possible.
